func work(_ item: Int) async {}

final class Runner {
  var items: [Int] = []
  var tasks: [Task<Void, Never>] = []

  // CASE string_apostrophe expect=pass
  func start() {
    for item in items {
      tasks.append(Task<Void, Never> {
        print("Don't block \(item)")
        await work(item)
      })
    }
  }
}
